items.title: Give directions using landmarks
items.prompt: A visitor is coming to your home for the first time. Give them directions from the nearest main road.

items.title: Repeat back a tricky request
items.prompt: Your teammate says: “I need the numbers by Thursday, but only the regional ones, and in the old format, not the new one.” Confirm what they need.

items.title: Apologize for missing a friend's dinner
items.prompt: Your friend says: “You missed my birthday dinner. Everyone kept asking where you were.” Respond.

items.title: Leave a crisp voicemail for a recruiter
items.prompt: A recruiter called while you were busy. Leave them a voicemail.

items.title: Teach a grandparent to use an app
items.prompt: Your grandparent wants to video-call the family but finds the app confusing. Talk them through it, step by step.

items.title: Convince a busy friend to start walking
items.prompt: Your friend says they're far too busy to exercise. Convince them to try a ten-minute walk every day this week.

items.title: Pitch your idea to an investor in a minute
items.prompt: You get one minute with an investor at a startup event. Pitch your idea, real or imagined.
